How does Bonded Warehouse work with WM?
Your cargo is admitted to Brazil with import taxes suspended and remains under the control of the Federal Revenue Service until it is nationalized.

As the consignee of the goods, WM takes care of all the documentary, fiscal and logistical management of the operation — from the international shipment to the admission process, registration of the Declaration of Admission (DA), and ongoing management of the bonded stock. We structure the best warehousing strategy that offers advantages for you and your client, combining logistical efficiency and tax planning.
